description: Group of toggle buttons built on Radix UI ToggleGroup, supporting single or multiple selection modes with shared variant and size context. Includes survey view toggle and theme switcher patterns.
useCases: Survey view mode switcher (Desktop / Tablet / Mobile preview)
Text alignment selector (left, center, right, justify) in editor toolbar
Theme toggle group (Light / Dark / System) in settings
Multi-select filter tags with toggle-on/off behavior
